We shipped 412 orders in October. In March it was 9.

Nothing clever happened. We fixed one thing: the size chart. Returns for "too small" were 31% of all returns, so we measured 40 pairs ourselves, rewrote the chart in centimetres, and put a photo of a tape measure next to it.

Returns dropped to 11%. Reviews went from 3.9 to 4.4.

I wish I'd done it in April. If you sell clothes online, measure your own product before you touch your ads.
